1.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3ADJUSTTOOL_00539_A1_000_001
1.translation_description: Potenzia l’arma di Eureka con i mnemi.

4.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3ADJUSTTOOL_00539_SYSTEM_000_000
4.description: You do not possess a Eureka weapon which can be enhanced with mnemes.
4.translation_description: Non possiedi un’arma di Eureka potenziabile con i mnemi.

8.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3ADJUSTTOOL_00539_SYSTEM_000_010
8.description: You do not have the required <hex:02310DFF054974656D04F25E3A030203> to enhance <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203> with mnemes.
8.translation_description: Non possiedi <hex:02310DFF054974656D04F25E3A030203> a sufficienza per potenziare <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203> con i mnemi.

13.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3ADJUSTTOOL_00539_A2_000_001
13.translation_description: Potenziamento delle armi di Eureka con i mnemi.

16.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3ADJUSTTOOL_00539_MANUAL00539_000_020
16.description: (-Mnemeworks Manual-)“It is strongly recommended that you familiarize yourself with all aspects of the mnemeworks station before attempting to enhance an armament. Failure to do so may lead to catastrophic failure and/or grievous bodily harm and/or death...”
16.translation_description: (-Manuale Mnemeworks-)«Prima di potenziare un’arma, ti consigliamo vivamente di familiarizzare con tutti gli aspetti della postazione Mnemeworks. In caso contrario, potresti causare un guasto catastrofico, lesioni gravi o persino la morte...»

17.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3ADJUSTTOOL_00539_SYSTEM_000_021
17.description: Through the use of the mnemeworks, you may imbue your Pyros weapon with additional properties.
17.translation_description: La postazione Mnemeworks permette di infondere alla tua arma di Pyros proprietà aggiuntive.

18.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3ADJUSTTOOL_00539_SYSTEM_000_022
18.description: The strength and nature of these properties will be determined at random. Moreover, should you possess sufficient materials, this process may be repeated.
18.translation_description: La potenza e la natura di queste proprietà sono determinate casualmente. Inoltre, puoi ripetere il processo se hai materiali sufficienti.

19.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3ADJUSTTOOL_00539_MANUAL00539_000_030
19.description: (-Mnemeworks Manual-)“Please ensure you have sufficient <hex:02310DFF054974656D04F25E3A030203> before utilizing the mnemeworks station. Failure to do so may lead to catastrophic failure and/or grievous bodily harm and/or death...”
19.translation_description: (-Manuale Mnemeworks-)«Prima di usare la postazione Mnemeworks, assicurati di avere <hex:02310DFF054974656D04F25E3A030203> a sufficienza. In caso contrario, potresti causare un guasto catastrofico, lesioni gravi o persino la morte...»

20.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3ADJUSTTOOL_00539_SYSTEM_000_031
20.description: In order to enhance a Pyros weapon, you must possess the requisite quantity of <hex:02310DFF054974656D04F25E3A030203>.
20.translation_description: Per potenziare un’arma di Pyros, devi possedere la quantità necessaria di <hex:02310DFF054974656D04F25E3A030203>.

21.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3ADJUSTTOOL_00539_SYSTEM_000_032
21.translation_description: La quantità varia a seconda dell’arma. Per un paladino servono <hex:020844E802FF38020834E2E8020BFF26020922E802FF0231FF0232FF0233FF0234FF0235FF0236FF0237FF0238FF0239FF03313003FF07022003E8020303FF07022003E8020303> per l’arma e altrettanti per lo scudo. Per tutte le altre armi servono <hex:020844E804FF38020834E2E8040BFF26020922E804FF0231FF0232FF0233FF0234FF0235FF0236FF0237FF0238FF0239FF03313003FF07022003E8040303FF07022003E8040303> <hex:02310DFF054974656D04F25E3A030203>.

22.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3ADJUSTTOOL_00539_SYSTEM_000_033
22.description: <hex:022B13FF1102310DFF054974656D04F25E3A03020303> are created by converting accumulated vitiated aether with the aid of a Mark II crystal forge.
22.translation_description: I <hex:022B13FF1102310DFF054974656D04F25E3A03020303> si ottengono convertendo l’etere corrotto accumulato con l’aiuto di una Forgia di Cristallo Mark II.

23.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3ADJUSTTOOL_00539_SYSTEM_000_034
23.description: Please be advised that <hex:02310DFF054974656D04F25E3A030203> can only be obtained via the Mark II crystal forge located in <hex:02281CFF17436F6E74656E7446696E646572436F6E646974696F6EE8022C03>, and that crystal forges located elsewhere will not yield this material.
23.translation_description: Ricorda che puoi ottenere <hex:02310DFF054974656D04F25E3A030203> solo tramite la Forgia di Cristallo Mark II a <hex:02281CFF17436F6E74656E7446696E646572436F6E646974696F6EE8022C03>; le Forge di Cristallo altrove non producono questo materiale.
